subject: Request: VM cadence + remediation witness artifacts for SOC2 SIG
messages:
From: Chris Lowe <chris.lowe@finaltas.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.menon@finaltas.com>
Date: 2026-10-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: VM artifacts request for SIG review

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As part of our SIG review we need a compact set of artifacts that prove Redwood's vulnerability management cadence and remediation behavior. Specifically can you provide:

- The recent authenticated/internal scan schedule and proof (who/when ran the last 3 runs)
- Remediation confirmation for CVE-2026-4512 (we've flagged it as high) — a short attestation and any rollback plan
- SLA table that maps CVSS tiers to remediation windows (e.g., P1: 7 days)
- A manifest of exported scan findings (CSV or similar) and a runbook describing scanning ownership and handoff

We need this for our SOC2 evidence pack; delivery by COB Tue 2026-10-12 would be ideal. Let me know if you need an NDA or an additional contact.

Cheers,
Chris
Security Engineer, FinAtlas
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Chris Lowe <chris.lowe@finaltas.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-10T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VM artifacts request for SIG review

Chris — thanks for the clear list. We're able to compile everything on your cadence. Quick notes:

- Scan cadence: authenticated internal scans run weekly (full host + container image), quarterly authenticated deep scans, and daily external agentless discovery. We also run weekly dependency checks against our SBOM ingestion.
- SLA mapping: our internal SLA for high/critical CVEs is 7 days (P1), medium 30 days, low 90 days. We include compensating controls for exceptions.
- CVE-2026-4512: already remediated in production by a targeted patch rolled out 2026-10-02. We will attach a signed remediation affirmation and the rollback checklist.

I added Marissa (security) to validate technical artifacts and Ben (sales/CS) to include contract-level language if you need a formal attestation letter. We'll deliver the manifest + runbook and the affirmation by EOD Tue 2026-10-12.

--
Kimberly Park
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, Chris Lowe <chris.lowe@finaltas.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-11T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VM artifacts request for SIG review

Chris / Kimberly — attaching the technical detail you'll want. Highlights:

- Scan proof: we've exported the last three authenticated scan runs (2026-09-18, 2026-09-25, 2026-10-02). The CSV includes host identifiers (hashed), finding ids, CVSS, first/last seen, and remediation state.
- CVE-2026-4512 remediation timeline:
  * 2026-09-29: vulnerability discovered by dependency scan (SBOM)
  * 2026-09-30: triage and assignment to infra-team
  * 2026-10-01: patched in staging and integration tests run
  * 2026-10-02: staged rollout to prod with canary and verification checks
  * 2026-10-04: full rollout complete; post-deploy verification passed

- Evidence artifacts included: remediation logs, PR references, and the patch-run id. We redacted internal PII/hostnames per our evidence handling policy.

If FinAtlas prefers a signed PDF attestation on company letterhead for their SIG binder, Ben can coordinate.

Attachments referenced below.

Marissa
Director, Vulnerability Management
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Chris Lowe <chris.lowe@finaltas.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-12T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VM artifacts request for SIG review — attestation and contract note

Hi Chris — forwarding the formal attestation as requested. Short summary for your SIG binder:

- Redwood VM SLA: Critical/High (CVSS >= 7.0) — 7 calendar days to remediation or documented compensating control; Medium 30 days; Low 90 days.
- Evidence provided: run manifest CSV, remediation affirmation (signed), and runbook describing scan ownership, cadence, and escalation paths.
- Exceptions: For customer-impacting rollbacks or coordinated releases we offer a documented exception process with a compensating control window; exceptions are signed off by the security ops manager.

I'll drop a signed PDF (cve-2026-4512-remediation-affirmation.pdf) in the thread. Let me know if you also need a short statement describing our continuous monitoring (we can include token-level audit traces if required under an NDA).

Regards,
Ben Carter
Account Executive (Enterprise)
Redwood Inference
From: Chris Lowe <chris.lowe@finaltas.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-12T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VM artifacts request for SIG review — received

Team — received and reviewed the artifacts. Asha and I validated the CSV and the remediation timeline; the rollout evidence and the signed affirmation are sufficient for our SIG pack. A couple of small asks:

1) Can you include the exact runbook step that triggers customer notification for a P1 remediation (we want wording for our auditor)?
2) Please confirm that the exported CSV includes the vulnerability digest id that maps to the original finding (so our tracker can reconcile).

If you can email those two items tomorrow morning we'll close the item and proceed with SOC2 evidence ingestion. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Chris
Security Engineer, FinAtlas
